---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with population reports, tests, builds or deployment
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## Describe the bug
Explain what went wrong and which report or feature is affected.

## Steps to reproduce
1. State the branch, release or commit used.
2. Give the command or report method and its input values.
3. Describe the problem that occurred.

## Expected result
Describe the correct output or behaviour.

## Actual result
Include the output, error message or incorrect population figures.

## Environment
- Operating system
- Java and Maven versions
- Running in IntelliJ, Docker or GitHub Actions
- Database version and dataset

## Evidence
Attach screenshots, relevant logs or a link to the failed Actions run.
Remove passwords, tokens and other private information from logs.

## Impact
Explain which users or reports are affected and any available workaround.
